title: A tier name taken by someone else is shown inline on save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a second browser session open, signed in as another Admin with the same permissions.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Type a name no other tier uses (for example Fleet Gold).
  4. In the second session, rename tier A to the same name.
  5. Click Create Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Tier page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name shows.

Step 4:

  • The second session renames tier A.

Step 5:

  • The tier is not created: the page shows inline that the name is taken.
  • The typed name is still in the field.
